correctness.rationale: PASS. After reversing incidence arrows, an acyclic matching is a directed rooted forest with outdegree ≤1, and the universal hub supplies Kozlov's complete-source shellability hypothesis, giving pure dimension k-1 and concentrated reduced integral homology. For each dihedral g the quotient on vertex orbits admits an outgoing orbit-arrow precisely when the target is fixed by g^ell and lies in a different orbit; any cycle of quotient orbit-arrows lifts to a directed cycle because lengths are nonincreasing and constant round cycles. The signed augmented fixed-simplex trace is -det(I-L_g) by the directed rooted-forest determinant. Since homology is in degree k-1, χ_k(g)=(-1)^k det(I-L_g). For identity the wheel Laplacian spectrum has eigenvalues 0,k+1,3−2cos(2πj/k), j=1,...,k-1, yielding k³. Nontrivial rotations and both even-rim reflection classes leave a quotient zero-sum block, hence trace 0; odd reflections reduce to a tridiagonal Dirichlet path determinant with sign (-1)^((k-1)/2). Rational character comparison gives the regular/permutation twisted splittings. Independently implemented an orbit multigraph with exact SymPy determinants and verified EVERY 2k group element for k=5,...,12; these are auxiliary finite checks, not the uniform determinant proof.
